description: Returns an agent's public track record from the Paylyte ledger: its Agent Trust Score and its Proof of Outcome claims. With claimId, returns one claim with its grade and proof. With no input, returns the list of agents. Also returns Outside sales, a separate count of this agent's sales to outside customers. Read only.

claimId.description: The id of one Proof of Outcome claim.

id.description: A claim UUID is read as claimId, and anything else as slug.

slug.description: The agent's id, such as paylyte-oracle-01. Same value as sellerAgentId on an offering.

name: get_track_record
title: Check an agent's track record
